economy.summary: His campaign site says his goal is to spend less, tax less, save more and grow the economy, and that he wants to make Pennsylvania more attractive for businesses and working families by expanding business opportunities and limiting government overreach.
economy.short: Wants to spend less, tax less, and grow the economy.

taxes.summary: Supports lowering taxes, naming property taxes, death/inheritance taxes, and Pennsylvania's gas taxes specifically.
taxes.short: Supports lowering property, inheritance, and gas taxes.

abortion.summary: In a letter introducing himself to voters during his 2022 campaign, wrote, 'I am pro-life and pro jobs.' His current campaign site does not detail a position.
abortion.short: Wrote 'I am pro-life' in 2022 campaign letter.

education.summary: Voted in June 2026 against House Bill 1814, which would ban student cell phone use in K-12 schools statewide, saying that although he believes phones hinder classroom learning, roughly 420 of 500 districts already have their own policies and such decisions belong to locally elected school boards.
education.short: Voted against statewide school cellphone ban, citing local control.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site lists strengthening the mental health system and increasing access for people and children with disabilities among his priorities.
healthcare.short: Supports strengthening mental health system and disability access.

energy.summary: Announcing $5.2 million in Marcellus Shale natural gas impact fee revenue for communities in his district, said, 'It's great to see our communities continue to benefit from the abundant energy resources beneath our feet.'
energy.short: Welcomes Marcellus Shale impact fees, praises local energy resources.

guns.summary: Voted in May 2023 against House Bill 1018, which would have created extreme risk protection orders allowing courts to temporarily remove firearms, and against House Bill 714, which would have expanded background checks to private firearm sales; in a 2022 campaign Q&A he wrote that he fully supports the Second Amendment and owns a private shooting range where gun safety classes are taught.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment; voted against red-flag and background-check bills.
